name: Outdoor Fund Local Impact Grants

funder.name: Bass Pro Shops and Cabela's Outdoor Fund

summary: Small rolling grants for nonprofits and public bodies in the US and Canada running specific wildlife and habitat conservation projects near Bass Pro Shops and Cabela's stores. No operating costs, construction or projects still in design.

geography.label: United States and Canada, near retail locations

status.quote: Guidelines: Application Timeline: Rolling Requested Grant Amount: Up to $5,000.

applicant_types.quote: Organization Eligibility U.S: Must be a municipality, public institution, or registered with the IRS as a 501(c)(3) or other 501(c) determination.

geography.quote: Must be a municipality, public institution, or registered with the IRS as a 501(c)(3) or other 501(c) determination. Organization Eligibility Canada: Must be a provincially registered nonprofit

access.quote: Supporting local organizations and projects that engage communities near our retail locations and align with our conservation pillars of Conserving Wildlife and Habitat and Connecting New Audiences to the Outdoors. Apply Now
